title: Donald Trump … here’s something to think about
excerpt: from Native American Mark Charles. Quotable: Without Natives at the table, all we have is one generation of undocumented immigrants trying to decide what to do with another generation of undocumented immigrants, and there is no integrity in the conversation.
body:
from Native American Mark Charles. Quotable:

 Without Natives at the table, all we have is one generation of undocumented immigrants trying to decide what to do with another generation of undocumented immigrants, and there is no integrity in the conversation.
